chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"There is no objection if a man departs (from Mina) in the first departure, then stays in Meah."

key_terms.النَّفْرِ الْأَوَّلِ: The first departure (referring to leaving Mina on the 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah before sunset)

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim leave Mina early on the 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah and stay in Mecca instead?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the flexibility in the Sunnah of staying in Mina, distinguishing between the obligatory stay and the recommended duration. It reflects the scholarly consensus that leaving Mina after the first afternoon prayer on the 13th is permissible, allowing pilgrims to return to Mecca for the remaining days of Tashreeq, thereby accommodating those with specific needs or preferences.
